analysis: Exploratory between-site difference in distance of the same fraction to its own local PRE
primary: 39-assignment full cohort; nine paired site contrasts
unit: Woman; average repeated preparations within woman/site/fraction before matching
estimand: Equal-woman mean of site1 own-PRE distance minus site2 own-PRE distance among women with both sites for that fraction
test: Two-sided complete sign enumeration including observed assignment; assumes independently sampled women and sign-symmetric/exchangeable paired differences under null. Not randomized-site causal inference.
uncertainty: Pointwise percentile woman-bootstrap intervals, 5000 draws per contrast; NumPy linear quantile. Intervals are not simultaneous and do not replace BH.
multiplicity: BH nine new between-site contrasts within each taxon-arm/cohort scope; also BH18 over nine historical within-site fraction and nine between-site tests. Unestimable single-woman comparisons enter adjustment as p=1, but no inferential p/q/CI is reported for them. Sensitivities are not independent replication.
limitations: Missing pairs not imputed; eligible women differ by fraction/site contrast. Anatomy is observational; storage, processing and missingness may confound site-associated differences. Source taxonomy/metadata limitations persist. No inference of antibody-driven effects, viability or storage equivalence.
